rv.q: Aaron and Luna share several moments of raw emotion, which Wilde and Wols deliver with honesty and vulnerability.

Man and Moon , an absolutely beautiful two-hander from Siena Marilyn Ledger, is an emotional and poignant—yet humorous—exploration of gender, puberty, death, and the universal need to, as the old ads used to say, reach out and touch someone.
Man and Moon remains a moving testament to unlikely friendships wherever you may find them and the quiet bravery of living with a potentially terminal illness.
